title: Simulation Setup Generation
body:
This record covers Simulation Setup Generation within the Computational Fluid Dynamics Generator Database. Creates simulation setups, boundary conditions and analysis reports. The record is written as a complete, human-readable file: it states what the method is, when it applies, what it needs, what it produces, and where its limits lie.

How it works. Flow-setup method: geometry, mesh, boundary conditions, and solver settings are packaged as one reproducible setup, then checked against reference cases. In a simple case the method is applied to a single, well-defined item; in a compounded case several items are combined and their interactions are tracked; in the most complex case the full chain is carried end to end with checks at each stage.

Worked example. The demo program attached to this record executes the worked calculation for this topic at build time, and its output is stored beside the code so any reader can compare the two. The numbers in the demo are ordinary working values for this topic, chosen so the arithmetic can be checked by hand as well as by running the program.

Scope and limits. This record describes established practice and workable designs; it does not claim a live deployment, a vendor product, or an agency endorsement. Where a design is speculative it is labeled as a design, and the demo shows the calculation rather than a deployed system.

Further detail. This record also notes how simulation setup generation is reviewed over time: the method is re-checked against new examples, its limits are re-stated when the inputs change, and its demo is re-run whenever the record is revised, so the stored output always matches the stored code.

# Simulation Setup Generation: Reynolds number Re = rho*v*L/mu
